entry.title: New: Resolution 697 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF A SEARCH AND RESCUE CANINE WITH HANDLER TRAINING AND CERTIFICATION TO THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT

The donation from Hawai‘i Island K9 Association, with an estimated value of $25,000, would be utilized by the department’s Kealakehe Station in West Hawai‘i.
